visual.name: nexoraTable
visual.description: Nexora Table — a premium data table with Arabic-first RTL design. Cell heatmap, sparkline column, pinned first column, smart row capping up to 30,000 rows, cross-filter & row selection, search, percent/currency formats including the official Saudi Riyal symbol, full font controls, and Arabic/English localization. Part of the Nexora Suite by Nexora Analysis.
